metadata.description: House of Vibe Claude Code tools for builders.

plugins.name: token-eater
plugins.description: Spend expiring AI credits on isolated, verified code cleanup that opens a draft pull request and never merges.

rows: ⚡ **Use it or lose it** · your AI credits expire monthly; this spends the leftovers
🧹 **Safe cleanup** · works in an isolated copy, verifies + reviews its own changes
🛡️ **You stay in control** · opens a draft PR, never merges without you
card.run: Then run `/token-eater` on your messiest repo

plugins.name: pro-gate
plugins.description: Run a final pull request review using the Pro model selected by your ChatGPT account, with guided runtime setup and no automatic merge.

rows: ⚡ **The deepest review, last** · your ChatGPT Pro model reads the whole PR before merge
🔍 **Finds what earlier tiers missed** · logic, security, integrity, race conditions
🛡️ **You stay in control** · findings and a verdict, never an auto-merge
card.run: Then run `/pro-gate` on your next PR

plugins.name: skill-tuner
plugins.description: Tell whether a change to an agent-consumed document actually worked. /skill-tuner:tune probes a SKILL.md, AGENTS.md or CLAUDE.md, fixes what three independent skeptics confirm, and proves the description still routes. Paired comparison with a confidence interval, content-hashed provenance with drift detection, and it reads skill-creator benchmark output.

rows: ⚡ **Did that skill edit actually work?** · a before/after count on one document is not evidence
🔬 **Three skeptics, then a verdict** · confirmed defects fixed, and a paired comparison with a real confidence interval
🛡️ **You stay in control** · reports land as inputs to your decision; a reworded description ships only at routing parity
card.run: Then run `/skill-tuner:tune` on your most-used SKILL.md

plugins.name: wsl-cdp
plugins.description: Drive your real, logged-in Windows browser (Chrome, Edge, or Brave) from Claude Code inside WSL2 over the Chrome DevTools Protocol. Read authenticated dashboards, take real screenshots, and run a guided one-time setup; sends native-Windows users to the official extension instead.

card.tagline: Claude Code plugin · WSL2 only · 2-min setup · auto-updates
rows: ⚡ **Your real browser, driven from WSL2** · authenticated dashboards, real screenshots, sessions that survive reboots
🌉 **Bridges the VM boundary** · native messaging cannot cross it; wsl-cdp connects Claude Code to Chrome, Edge, or Brave over CDP
🛡️ **Sessions, never passwords** · a dedicated agent profile with browser sign-in disabled; log it into only what agents should touch
card.run: Then run `/wsl-cdp:setup` once and point your agent at a real dashboard

plugins.name: memory-dream
plugins.description: The sleep cycle for Claude Code's auto-memory. /memory-dream:dream runs an operator-gated consolidation pass: deterministic triage finds superseded, stale, and oversized notes, a zero-tool subagent drafts the fixes it cannot apply, and you approve each change by hand before anything is written. /memory-dream:eval measures whether recall actually improved. Also a standalone stdlib-only CLI; it never merges, deletes, or compresses a note on its own.

rows: ⚡ **Auto-memory rots** · notes go stale, supersede each other, and route Claude to old answers
🧠 **The missing sleep cycle** · deterministic triage, sandboxed drafting, and a recall eval that proves the pass helped
🛡️ **You stay in control** · every change is a diff you approve by hand; nothing merges or deletes on its own
card.run: Then run `/memory-dream:dream` on your busiest project

plugins.name: design-rails
plugins.description: Guardrails that keep AI agents on your design system. Posture-check whether a real, agent-wired, CI-enforced design system exists, derive a Google-spec DESIGN.md from the code you already ship, put open taste decisions on visual pages for the human to pick, and ratchet drift budgets that only move down. Read-only on application source — it authors under design/ and never edits your code.

rows: ⚡ **Agents drift off your design system** · every PR nudges colors, spacing, and components a little further apart
📐 **Rails, not vibes** · a DESIGN.md derived from the code you ship, taste calls on visual pages, drift budgets that only move down
🛡️ **Read-only on your source** · it authors under design/ and never edits your application code
card.run: Then ask your agent to posture-check your design system with `/design-rails`
